verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same series, read in Lean's variable order and with the shift separated off. Lean's Taylor variable is z.1 = σ and its spatial variable z.2 = x; the paper's passage to t = 1 + σ is the separate definition rightExtension (take T = 1), rightExtension a ha T (t,x) = extension a ha (t-T, x). The paper's coefficients F_j(x) are Lean's a j x (at the use site in SpacetimeGluing.smoothExtension they are normalTrace T f j, the time jets at the joining time). The paper's increasing integers b_j ≥ 1 are scale a ha j, a positive natural (scale_pos) and strictly monotone (scale_strictMono). The paper's χ_0 ∈ C_c^∞(ℝ), one near zero and zero for arguments at least one, is SmoothCutoffs.cutoff, a ContDiffBump equal to 1 on |s| ≤ 1/2 and 0 for |s| ≥ 1; Lean's cutoff also vanishes for s ≤ -1, which the paper neither asks for nor excludes. Index set, the j! normalization and the scalar-times-vector structure agree term by term.
